description: This file defines template classes for managing web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, within a Web namespace. It includes classes for handling transfer states, link management, hash calculation, and request/response processing, specifically for WebTransfer functionality.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a singleton element of type ELEMENT, providing access via the Element() method.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including states for idle, info, upload, and download, with internal link management and hash validation.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests, file storage, authorization, and response generation.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request, opening a channel if necessary.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the transfer channel and releases resources.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information from a source URL, preparing for transfer.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a local destination.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to set up remote connection parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when transfer is complete.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize incoming requests.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Handles attaching a body to a request or response.

methods.name: _CalculateHash
methods.description: Calculates hash for the file body if hashing is enabled.

methods.name: _ValidateHash
methods.description: Validates the hash signature if hashing is enabled.

methods.name: _LoadHash
methods.description: Loads hash context for the file body if supported.
